title: Degree-zero localization of sections on an affine scheme
statement: Let $Y$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\mathcal L$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_Y$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], let $s\in\Gamma(Y,\mathcal L)$, and let $\mathcal F$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Define $H^0_*(Y,\mathcal L,\mathcal F)=\bigoplus_{n\in\mathbb Z}\Gamma(Y,\mathcal F\otimes\mathcal L^{\otimes n})$ with the tensor-power convention for negative $n$, and let $H^0_*(Y,\mathcal L,\mathcal F)_{(s)}$ be the degree-zero part of its localization at the homogeneous element $s$ of degree $1$. If $Y_s$ is the nonvanishing locus of $s$ [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module], then the canonical map $H^0_*(Y,\mathcal L,\mathcal F)_{(s)}\to\Gamma(Y_s,\mathcal F|_{Y_s})$ sending a fraction $\xi/s^n$ to $s^{-n}\xi$ is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sc-p1-invertible-section-localization] with $X=Y$. Its quasi-compact and quasi-separated hypotheses hold by Step 1, and its invertible module, section, quasi-coherent module, nonvanishing locus, graded module, degree-zero localization, and canonical fraction map specialize verbatim to the objects and map in this item. Therefore the canonical map $H^0_*(Y,\mathcal L,\mathcal F)_{(s)}\to\Gamma(Y_s,\mathcal F|_{Y_s})$ sending $\xi/s^n$ to $s^{-n}\xi$ is an isomorphism.

lean.statement: theorem affine_section_localization (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine Y] (L : Y.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (s : Γ(L, ⊤)) (F : Y.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] : ∃ U : Y.Opens, (U : Set Y) = nonvanishingLocus L s ∧ ∃ e : SectionFractionPresentation L F s ≃+ Γ(F, U), (∀ (r : Γ(Y, ⊤)) (z : SectionFractionPresentation L F s), e (r • z) = (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show U ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op r) • e z) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (t : Γ(F ⊗ L.tensorPow n, ⊤)), tmulSection (e (sectionFraction L F s n t)) (tensorPowSectionOne (homOfGlobalSection L s) n U) = (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n).presheaf.map (homOfLE (show U ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op t)
